name: lazyeditmirror
description: LazyEditMirror - a Premiere Pro UXP panel that mirrors the Front Camera edit (cuts, gaps, timing) onto the Side Camera track, synced by audio.
author: Raisul Sohan

scripts.check: node --check main.js && node --check plan.js && node --check premiere.js && node --check sync.js && node --check log.js && node --check helper.js && node --check helper/audio.js && node --check helper/sync-helper.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && node tools/test-plan.mjs && node tools/test-audio.mjs && node tools/test-sync.mjs
